name: Discord
description: Post task events from this project to a Discord channel using an incoming webhook.

settings.label: Channel webhook URL
settings.description: Create a webhook in Discord (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks) and paste the URL here.

settings.label: Triggers
settings.description: Choose which task events should post to this channel.

settings.label: Only notify when status changes (for task.updated)
settings.description: When enabled, task.updated is skipped unless the kanban or list status actually changed.
